Level 2. Up to three creatures gain 5 to their hit point maximum and their current hit points until your next long rest. 5 more per level above 2.

Level 4. One creature you can see within 30 feet: Charisma save, or it is sent to a harmless demiplane - off the board, and incapacitated there - until the spell ends, when it comes back where it left. Held for the full minute, an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey or fiend doesn't come back. One more creature per level above 4. Requires concentration.

Level 4. Tentacles fill a 20-foot square of difficult terrain. A creature there when they appear, entering, or ending its turn there makes a Strength save or takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained. An action and an Athletics check breaks free. Requires concentration.

Level 6. A wall of whirling blades up to 100 feet long, or a ring 60 feet across. It gives three-quarters cover and is difficult terrain. A creature in it when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 6d10 force damage, half on a success. Requires concentration.

Level 1. 4d6 radiant damage, on a hit; the next attack roll against it has advantage.

Level 3. A willing creature's speed doubles, it gains +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saves, and it has one extra action each turn for a single weapon attack, Dash, Disengage or Hide. When the spell ends it is incapacitated and cannot move until the end of its next turn. Requires concentration.
Level 6. Restores 70 hit points and ends the blinded, deafened and poisoned conditions. 10 more hit points per level above 6.
Level 1. Bonus action. Restores 2d4 plus your spellcasting modifier hit points.
Level 1. Reaction, when you are hurt. 2d10 fire damage, dex save for half.

Level 1. Bonus action. 1d6 necrotic damage whenever you hit the target with an attack roll, and disadvantage on its checks with an ability you choose. If it drops to 0 hit points, a bonus action on a later turn curses a new creature. Requires concentration.

Level 1. A creature makes a Wisdom save or falls prone laughing, incapacitated and unable to stand. It saves again at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, with advantage then. One more creature per level above 1. Requires concentration.
Level 5. A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. One more target per level above 5. Requires concentration.
Level 2. A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. One more target per level above 2. Requires concentration.

Level 1. Bonus action. 1d6 force damage whenever you hit the marked creature with an attack roll. If it drops to 0 hit points, a bonus action moves the mark to a new creature you can see. Requires concentration.

Level 3. Every creature in a 30-foot cube that can see the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, incapacitated and unable to move. It ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken awake. Requires concentration.

Level 4. 2d10 bludgeoning damage in a 20-foot burst, dex save for half; 4d6 cold damage in a 20-foot burst, the same save for half; fills 20 feet around the point, difficult terrain. 1d10 more bludgeoning per level above 4.
Level 1. Takes a minute to cast (or as a ritual) - not in a fight. Touch an object to learn its magical properties, or a creature to learn which spells are affecting it.
Level 2. A creature you touch is invisible until the spell ends - or until it makes an attack roll, deals damage or casts a spell. One more creature per level above 2. Requires concentration.
Level 2. Bonus action. A creature you touch is freed of one condition, chosen as you cast: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.
Level 3. 8d6 lightning damage in a 100-foot line, dex save for half.
Level 1. Armor Class 13 plus Dexterity while wearing no armor.
Cantrip. Its effect is told by the narrator.
Level 1. Three glowing darts, each striking a creature you can see for 1d4+1 force damage - they never miss. One more dart per level above 1.
Level 3. An illusion of an object, creature or other sight up to a 20-foot cube; its effect is told by the narrator. Requires concentration - unless cast with a level 4 slot or higher.

Level 8. No save: a creature you can see within 60 feet is banished into a labyrinth, off the board, until the spell ends. On its turn it can study the maze - a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check - and escapes on a success, ending the spell. It comes back where it left. Requires concentration.
Level 9. 20d6 fire damage in 4 40-foot bursts, dex save for half; 20d6 bludgeoning damage in 4 40-foot bursts, the same save for half.
Cantrip. Its effect is told by the narrator.

Level 2. Three illusory duplicates of you for the fight. Each time you are hit, roll a d6 for each duplicate left; on any 3 or higher a duplicate takes the hit and vanishes instead. Attackers that are blinded or have truesight are not fooled.
Level 2. Bonus action. You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Level 2. A beam of moonlight 5 feet around a point: Constitution save or 2d10 radiant damage when it appears, when a creature enters it, and when a creature ends its turn there, half on a success. A shape-shifted creature that fails reverts to its true form and can't shift again until it leaves. An action moves it up to 60 feet on a later turn. 1d10 more per level above 2. Requires concentration.
Level 2. An aura 30 feet around you: you and your allies inside it have +10 to Stealth and leave no tracks. Requires concentration.
Level 4. Grants 30 temporary hit points. Requires concentration. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
Level 9. A creature with 100 hit points or fewer dies; anything else takes 12d12 psychic damage.

Level 8. No save. A creature with 150 hit points or fewer is stunned and makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end it. A tougher creature cannot move until the start of your next turn.
Cantrip. Its effect is told by the narrator.

Cantrip. Bonus action. A flame in your hand lights 20 feet around you for the fight. While it lasts, you can take an action to hurl it at a creature within 60 feet: a ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire damage. A die more at levels 5, 11 and 17.

Level 5. Takes an hour to cast - not in a fight. A creature dead no more than ten days comes back with 1 hit point, its poisons gone. It takes -4 to attacks, saves and checks, easing by 1 each long rest. Nothing brings back a creature turned to dust.
Cantrip. 1d8 cold damage, on a hit; -10 feet of speed.
Level 3. Every curse on the creature you touch ends, whatever its level.
Cantrip. 1d8 radiant damage, dex save to avoid it.
Level 2. Three rays of fire, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire damage on a hit. One more ray per level above 2.

Level 1. Bonus action, right after you hit with a melee attack: 1d6 fire damage more, and the target burns - 1d6 fire at the start of each of its turns, then a Constitution save to put it out. 1d6 more per level above 1.
Level 9. Grants 100 temporary hit points. Requires concentration. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
Level 2. 3d8 thunder damage in a 10-foot burst, con save for half.
Level 1. Reaction, when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, against that attack too, and Magic Missile does you no harm.

Cantrip. Bonus action. For the fight your club or quarterstaff can use your spellcasting ability, rolls a d8 for damage and can deal force damage. The die grows to d10 at level 5, d12 at 11 and 2d6 at 17.
Cantrip. 1d8 lightning damage, on a hit; it can't make opportunity attacks.
Level 1. Its effect is told by the narrator. Requires concentration.

Level 1. Creatures of your choice in a 5-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or are incapacitated. At the end of their next turn they save again, and a second failure puts them to sleep. Damage or a shake wakes them. Elves and the sleepless are immune. Requires concentration.

Level 3. Sleet fills a 20-foot radius, blocking sight and making difficult terrain. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save or falls prone and loses its concentration. Requires concentration.

Level 3. Up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube: Wisdom save, or its speed is halved, it takes -2 to AC and Dexterity saves, can't take reactions, takes an action or a bonus action but not both, and makes only one attack. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Requires concentration. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
Cantrip. A creature within 15 feet at 0 hit points and not dead becomes stable. The range doubles at levels 5, 11 and 17.
Level 1. Its effect is told by the narrator.
Level 3. Its effect is told by the narrator.
Level 2. Fills 20 feet around the point, difficult terrain; 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet moved through it. Requires concentration.

Level 3. Spirits surround you for 15 feet: other creatures' speed is halved there, and one that enters or ends its turn there makes a Wisdom save or takes 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice as you cast), half on a success. 1d8 more per level above 3. Requires concentration.

Level 2. Bonus action. A spectral weapon appears within 60 feet and makes a melee spell attack against a creature beside it: 1d8 plus your spellcasting modifier in force damage. On later turns a bonus action moves it up to 20 feet and attacks again. 1d8 more per level above 2. Requires concentration.

Level 3. A 20-foot sphere of gas that blocks sight. A creature that starts its turn in it makes a Constitution save or is poisoned for that turn and can take no action or bonus action. Requires concentration.
Level 4. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage. Requires concentration.

Level 6. A 60-foot line of sunlight: 6d8 radiant damage and blinded until the start of your next turn, Constitution save for half and no blinding. You can take an action to fire a new beam on later turns. Sheds sunlight around you. Requires concentration.

Level 8. A 60-foot burst of sunlight: 12d6 radiant damage and blinded for the fight, Constitution save for half and no blinding. The blinded save again at the end of each of their turns. Burns away magical darkness in the area.

Level 5. When you cast it and with an action on later turns: move a Huge or smaller creature up to 30 feet (Strength save to resist) and hold it restrained until the end of your next turn, or pull an object from a creature's grip (Strength save to resist). Requires concentration.
Level 7. Moves you elsewhere. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
Cantrip. Its effect is told by the narrator.

Level 1. A wave of thunderous force in a 15-foot cube from you: Constitution save, or 2d8 thunder damage and it is pushed 10 feet away from you; half damage and no push on a success. 1d8 more per level above 1.
Level 6. For an hour the creature has truesight: it sees the invisible and through magical darkness, and sees illusions for what they are.

Cantrip. Make one attack with the weapon you cast it with, using your spellcasting ability, dealing radiant damage or the weapon's own. At level 5 a hit deals 1d6 radiant more, 2d6 at 11 and 3d6 at 17.
Cantrip. 1d6 psychic damage, wis save to avoid it; disadvantage on its next attack roll, on the same failed save.
Level 4. Acid bursts in a 20-foot radius: 10d4 acid damage, Dexterity save for half. A creature that fails takes 5d4 more at the end of its next turn. 2d4 more per level above 4.

Level 4. An opaque wall of fire up to 60 feet long, or a ring 20 feet across. Creatures in it when it appears make a Dexterity save or take 5d8 fire damage, half on a success. After that, entering the wall, or ending a turn in it or within 10 feet of the side you chose, deals 5d8 fire. 1d8 more per level above 4. Requires concentration.
Level 5. Raises a cube of invisible force, 20 feet on a side, on the edges of the squares: nothing walks through it, and everything is seen through it. Requires concentration.

Level 2. Fills a 20-foot cube with webs: difficult terrain and lightly obscured. A creature that enters or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save or is restrained, and can use an action and a Strength check to break free. Requires concentration.
Level 9. Its effect is told by the narrator. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
